create_AutoFeatureExtractor_from_pretrai: create an AutoFeatureExtractor instance from a pretrained model name or local path
load_get_feature_extractor_config: load the feature extractor configuration dict from a pretrained model repo or local directory
resolve_feature_extractor_class_from_nam: resolve a feature extractor class object by its string name from the transformers library
register_custom_feature_extractor: register a custom feature extractor class with a config class in the auto mapping
build_FEATURE_EXTRACTOR_MAPPING: build a lazy auto-mapping from model config types to feature extractor classes
